text: I also read on forums some swear it stops the seizure from going any further, and there was one woman whose EEG showed fewer seizure discharges on the days she smoked. But other people say THC vapes and concentrates brought their seizures on. That matches what happened in rats that get the brief staring seizures called absence seizures: high-THC smoke gave them more of those seizures, while injected CBD cut the number about in half. So the THC may be what makes cannabis go either way.
reader: someone with a person who is having, or about to have, a seizure from MDMA or a psychedelic overdose, which is generalized, and who wants to know what can stop it now
